text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HAARETZ
- Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu and Palestinian President Arafat meet after midnight at Erez crossing to sign Hebron accord.
- Jerusalem building contractor killed by Palestinian labourer, who flees.
- Israel protests against South African plans to sell weapons systems to Syria.
- Immigration to Israel drops eight percent to 71,300 in 1996.
YEDIOTH AHRONOTH
- Netanyahu and Arafat meet at Erez to complete Hebron deal.
- Israeli cabinet to hold special session.
MAARIV
- Netanyahu and Arafat meet at Erez to removed final obstacles to Hebron deal.
- Palestinian labourer kills Israeli contractor and flees to self-rule areas.
GLOBES
- Bank of Israel forced to intervene in forex trading to support the basket of foreign currencies.
- Banks call plan to raise reserve requirement damaging to stability of the banking system.
- December CPI expected to be between 0.5 percent and 0.8 percent.
JERUSALEM POST
- Netanyahu, Arafat meet at Erez
- Settlers step up lobbying effort.
- Police: Terror likely motive in Jerusalem murder.
